rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial intensifier for emphatic evaluations such as “absolutely brilliant.”

example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 zeng3

rows.note: Use this before an adjective when “absolutely” means simply “very,” as in 好叻 or 好靚.

example.jyutping: nei5 gam1 jat6 hou2 leng3 wo3

rows.note: Use this when “absolutely” means completely or wholly, especially with negatives or descriptions of a state.

example.english: I absolutely don't understand what you're saying.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jyun4 cyun4 m4 ming4 nei5 gong2 mat1

rows.note: Use this for strong, unconditional certainty or an absolute assertion rather than ordinary degree emphasis.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zyut6 deoi3 m4 wui5 ceot1 maai6 nei5
